contract.basis_compatibility_rule: A public-request notice normal form may realize only a notice kind and token pair that already appear in the imported status or carryforward basis object.
contract.emitted_notice_inheritance_rule: A notice normal form may factor one emitted notice into a canonical template-and-slot family, but it may not replace the emitted notice key or its reader-pointer order.
contract.slot_realization_rule: Every non-literal semantic phrase in the rendered sentence must come from an explicit slot whose source field is named in slot_bindings, and the rendered sentence must equal the emitted notice sentence exactly.
